annotations.text: Waste 2 Worth — 4 frontend directions. Each artboard shows the same 4 core screens: 1 Upload (drag & drop / choose file)  ·  2 Confirm the AI guess + pick 1 of 3 sizes  ·  3 Ideas grid (name + photo)  ·  4 Guide (tools first, then illustrated steps, then 3D compare). Pick the one that feels right and I'll build it for real.
